top_findings.title: MCP tools expose an empty inputSchema (no properties), so clients/LLMs cannot discover arguments
top_findings.evidence: main.cpp:74 toolList() builds every tool with inputSchema={"type":"object"} and no properties/required; args named only in the description string. _factual.json: the probe could not narrow the standings query, yielding an all-seasons 36-row/690-pt table.
top_findings.suggestion: Add a JSON-Schema properties block per tool enumerating each argument so an MCP client/LLM can form narrow calls.
